name: js-natural-sort
instruction: Implement naturalSort.js (CommonJS): module.exports = naturalSort. naturalSort(arr) returns a NEW array sorted in human/natural order: runs of digits compare NUMERICALLY, so 'file2' precedes 'file10'. Non-digit runs compare case-INSENSITIVELY first; only if they are equal ignoring case does a case-sensitive comparison break the tie, with lowercase before uppercase. When two strings differ only in leading zeros within a numeric run ('a01' vs 'a1'), the SHORTER run sorts first. The sort must be stable for fully equal strings and must not mutate the input.
